title: Section 17 Registration Act — Documents of which registration is compulsory

content.heading: Documents of which registration is compulsory
content.text: Documents of which registration is compulsory include: instruments of gift of immovable property; other non-testamentary instruments which purport or operate to create, declare, assign, limit or extinguish any right, title or interest of the value of one hundred rupees and upwards to or in immovable property; non-testamentary instruments acknowledging receipt or payment of consideration for such creation, declaration, assignment, limitation or extinction; leases of immovable property from year to year, or for any term exceeding one year, or reserving a yearly rent; and non-testamentary instruments transferring or assigning any decree, order or award that creates or extinguishes such a right of the value of one hundred rupees and upwards to or in immovable property. Further clauses address authorities to adopt and certain other instruments as enacted.
